sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C08299 and card C08299-K1. Between December 26 and December 30, 2016, five unauthorized online transactions totaling $170.15 were conducted across regions 330 and 203. The investigation was initiated after the customer explicitly reported a December 28 transaction of $30.02 as unrecognized. The illicit activity utilized two devices: D000024 (Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1366x768) and D009079 (Windows | Windows 10 | firefox 60.0 | 1600x900). Device D000024 was used for the initial transaction and is linked to prior confirmed fraud cases. Device D009079 connects this activity to another compromised card, C00750-K2, which is associated with a known fraud ring and proxy usage. Furthermore, the transactions shared a recipient email domain with other cards experiencing anomalous, high-scoring activity. The combination of the customer's direct dispute, high model scores, and strong device links to known fraud rings confirms the unauthorized nature of these transactions.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped because the direct customer report combined with independent graph evidence linking the devices to known fraud cases provided decisive proof of fraud, satisfying policy section 6.
